One phone each

The host runs the auction from their device. Friends open the invite link or scan the QR code and bid from their own phones. No accounts, no sign-up. Equal purses, live hammer, box office at the end.

Join a table

Type the host's 4-letter code, or just open the invite link they send you.

How it connects

  • Phones connect directly to the host's device. A free public matchmaking service only introduces them; the game itself never passes through a server.
  • Up to 4 studios per table. Fill empty seats with computer studios.
  • Keep the host's screen on. The host's device runs the clock and the computer studios.
  • Voice chat works the same way: tap the mic at the top to talk to everyone at the table. Earphones stop echo.
  • If someone can't connect, try everyone on the same Wi-Fi. Some mobile networks block direct connections.
  • Dropped out? Reopen the page and tap Rejoin. Your seat and signings are kept.

Photo studio

Every hero, heroine, director and banner comes with a photo. Swap any of them for your own; when you host, your table sees your swaps too.
